definitions.supplemental: Icel. ú-lyginn. Cf. O. H. Ger. lugín mendax.

quotations.old_english: Ceápige man on ðæs portgeréfan gewitnesse oþþe óðres unlygenes mannes

source_text: un-lygen; adj. Unlying, truthful :-- Ceápige man on ðæs portgeréfan gewitnesse oþþe óðres unlygenes mannes, L. Ath. i. 12; Th. i. 206, 10. [Icel. ú-lyginn. Cf. O. H. Ger. lugín mendax.] v. un-gelygen.
